description: Resolve one acupoint by code ("LI4", "li04"), English name ("Junction Valley"), Chinese name ("合谷") or pinyin ("Hegu", "hé gǔ") and return its location, cautions, meridian, the points most often selected alongside it in the corpus, its page URL and markdown twin. For the full protocol table, fetch the markdown twin. Where the best-evidenced indication for this point is covered by a $5 mini-guide, the result carries a `guide` pointer – offer it only if the person asks for something to follow at home.

point.description: Code, English name, Chinese name or pinyin (e.g. "LI4", "Hegu", "合谷")
